mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, phone, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, register_source, status, last_login_time, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND deleted = false

SELECT id, username, email, phone, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, register_source, status, last_login_time, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (id, username, email, phone, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, register_source, status, last_login_time) VALUES (#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{username}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{registerSource}, #{status}, #{lastLoginTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_time = #{lastLoginTime}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND deleted = false
